Hydraulic testing machine UH
Price inquiry 
Shimadzu proven models of UH (hydraulically or manualy closing grips / jaw) tensile and compression testing machines.  The frame capacity of tensile testing machines are available in 200kN, 300kN, 500kN, 1000kN, 2000kN, 3000kN and 4000kN capacities.  The testing machines are universal, i.e. they can be used for tensile, compression, bending tests of both materials and finished products.
Shimadzu's universal tensile testing machines are characterized by stability, long-term maintenance-free operation and accuracy, and are therefore used for testing heat-treated steels, beams, plates, etc.
The UH tensile testing machines can be operated with a computer and our excellent TRAPEZIUM-X software, or they can be operated as stand alone machine and the results can you read on a touch screen control panel where parameters for evaluating yield strength, tensile strength etc. can also be entered.
The testing machines UH series with hybrid power unit has an energy consumption reduction of up to 82%.
The auto-tuning function allows a smooth transition between test speeds and thus guarantees accurate measurements according to EN ISO 6892 while meeting the requirement of controlling the tensile testing machine by incremental elongation.
Force measurement fully meets or exceeds the following standards: ASTM E4, ISO7500-1, EN 100002-2, BS 1616, DIN 51221, JIS B7721.
Features and Specs
Key Features of the hydraulic testing machine:
The 10" display makes working with the machine considerably easier. 
The touch screen of the test machine also has a USB input. A test procedure can be saved on a conventional falsh disk, according to which the machine performs the test and then also saves the data on a flash disk.
Compliant with ISO 6892 and JIS Z2241 metallic materials tensile testing standards 
Specifications of the hydraulic testing machine:
Force measurement accuracy is 0.5% (1%) from 0.4%
In the TRAPEZIUM X software it is possible to choose from several modules (There is the CONCRETE module for concrete testing.)
It includes the function of constant test stress, constant strain, constant strain rate and constant stress, etc.
All types of grips / jaws / clamps, force gauges, strain gauge or vide strain gauge can be connected to the machine, thus tests for metallic and non-metallic materials can be realized
